explanation: Grigorchuk's gap conjecture: a finitely generated group of superpolynomial growth has growth ⪰ e^{√n}, i.e. e^{√n} ≤ γ_S(Cn) for some C and all large n. Grigorchuk's preorder also allows an outer constant (f ≤ C·g(Cn)), but that is absorbed: replacing n by 4n gives e^{2√n} ≥ C·e^{√n} eventually. So the formalization is equivalent. Quantifying over every finite generating set is fine, since growth classes do not depend on the generating set. The statement is faithful and open.
